feedback.problem:
Consider the matrix $T$ and the vector $v$ given below. If $T$ is the standard matrix of the linear transformation $T,$ find $T(v).$

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 4 & -1 \\ 5 & 1 & 3 \\ -1 & 3 & 4\end{aligned}],\,v=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 4 \\ -2\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Using the fact that $\,T(v)=T\cdot v,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}T(v) & =T\cdot v \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & 4 & -1 \\ 5 & 1 & 3 \\ -1 & 3 & 4\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}1 \\ 4 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}16 \\ 3 \\ 3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
